quantitative_conclusions: L500-L400 best: AbsRel-0.00054545 CI[-0.00230976,0.00143509], two seeds improve and one worsens. RMSE-0.00592760 improves in all three but its CI crosses zero; delta1-0.00001895 also crosses zero. F1-0.00914640 CI[-0.01295765,-0.00531904] worsens in all three, while band-0.00331301 CI[-0.00467203,-0.00180942] improves in all three.

L500-L400 final: F1-0.01111223 CI[-0.01464031,-0.00787144] worsens in the mean, with seed directions worse/better/worse. AbsRel-0.00032462, RMSE effectively unchanged, delta1-0.00041760 and band-0.00115643 all have CIs crossing zero. The previous two-seed final band gain is not retained as a three-seed CI-excluding-zero conclusion.

L500-R500 best: AbsRel-0.00480842, RMSE-0.01409756 and delta1+0.00344830 improve in all three seeds but scene CIs cross zero. F1+0.00757485 CI[0.00045591,0.01541699] improves in the mean with one tiny negative and two positive seed differences; band-0.00528631 CI[-0.00932990,-0.00085275] improves in all three. This adds a three-seed F1 result beyond the two-seed inconclusive comparison, with a CI close to zero.

L500-R500 final: only band-0.00651980 CI[-0.01044750,-0.00259930] excludes zero. AbsRel/RMSE/F1/delta1 CIs cross zero; final F1 is not an established advantage even though best F1 has a positive interval.

Versus B0 both endpoints improve AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/band in every seed with CIs excluding zero. Best F1+0.00587412 CI[-0.00126469,0.01400913] and final+0.00248421 CI[-0.00572867,0.01132355] cross zero; no general edge-detection gain versus the original model is established.

Final-best F1-0.00338991 CI[-0.00597004,-0.00074550] declines in the mean, with seed differences -0.00744335/+0.00448332/-0.00720970. AbsRel+0.00173735, RMSE+0.00475989, delta1-0.00647970 and band-0.00125510 have CIs crossing zero. Preserve the positive second-seed F1 counterexample.

All paired scene intervals use62 scenes/2000 resamples/seed320119,image-weighted metrics after matched-seed averaging. They quantify scene uncertainty conditional on the three trained seeds; sample SD is separate and comparisons are not multiplicity-adjusted. No test use or post-result configuration changes.
training_review: Best steps1500/1400/200, stops2500/2400/1200, mean1033.33+/-723.42 and2033.33+/-723.42. The large stopping dispersion must remain visible; an early stop is not proof of rapid stable convergence.

Stable0/3. Target0.10 confirmed at300/300/600. Target0.09 attained only by113, starting1000 and confirmed1200; not attained by112/114. Best mean slightly below0.09 is not the same as all seeds attaining and maintaining that target.

Seed114 validation jumps to0.10086525 at300 then partially recovers around0.093-0.094 without regaining best. Training loss keeps declining; the late-loss-down/validation-up indicator is true. This supports a generalization-gap/plateau interpretation, not proof of a single cause or a numerical collapse. Ten post-best observations are retained.

Seed114 has1200 attempted/1197 successful updates,9600 exposures,19.2 effective epochs. AMP skips103/213/1046 are recorded; their temporal proximity to validation changes is not causal evidence. No failure or restart. All three use73728 trainable parameters and4019.69238MiB peak allocated.

Seed114 best123.67182s, stop635.88392s,total699.19970s; loop452.20647s,selection182.97175s,detailed63.12749s,full attempt714.12797s. Three-seed total mean1132.30866+/-376.07637s. These are recorded wall times, loop includes loading; R cache-generation cost is separate, and observed seconds are not an isolated end-to-end compute benchmark.

Seed114 endpoint: AbsRel103 images improve/115 worsen; F1 83 improve/129 worsen/6 tie; band115 improve/103 worsen. Predicted edges480689->462972, matched GT305697->295998, zero-edge images3->9. Aggregate detection declines moderately; it is not the near-total collapse seen in the earlier J400 negative case.

qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0005: Final error increases on table/wall surfaces, AbsRel0.0561->0.0674, F1 0.389->0.350. Main chair contours remain, but the left tabletop has fewer matched cyan fragments. Board perimeter remains missed at both endpoints; final F1 is below B0 despite better overall depth.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0598: Positive endpoint example: AbsRel0.0457->0.0449 and F1 0.558->0.572, both better than B0. Tabletop sides remain well matched with small extra correct fragments and fewer incidental false fragments; sofa/leg gaps remain. This contradicts any claim that every fixed image loses edges.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_1440: Final broad wall/chair/counter error rises0.0919->0.1004, both worse than B00.0882. F1 falls0.540->0.531; main chair-post outline survives, some matched fragments shorten, and the spurious background-chair top line shrinks. Higher detection F1 than B0 does not remove the depth-value error.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0226: Final broad wall/person error increases0.2273->0.2523 and F1 drops0.512->0.483. Main person/column/sofa silhouette persists but some head/shoulder matches weaken; branches remain displaced with yellow false contours. Both endpoints improve B0 overall depth substantially, while final structure is less accurate.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0246: Final wall/foreground depth error worsens0.1461->0.1639, both worse than B0. F1 declines0.508->0.488 with added false shelf-top/side fragments, although the main foreground cyan contour remains. False ceiling and missed narrow structure persist.
qualitative_best_final_cases.nyuv2_0080: Final recovers longer matched shelf vertical fragments: predicted edges534->608,F1 0.510->0.567, both much better than B00.162. However AbsRel worsens0.0613->0.0789, mainly broader curtain/wall value error. This directly illustrates an edge-detection improvement with poorer overall depth.

interpretation: All three L500 best models improve overall depth versus B0 and outperform their matched R500 best models numerically, but scene uncertainty prevents a firm overall-accuracy superiority claim over R500 or L400. Compared with L400, best boundary-band depth error improves while F1 worsens consistently. L500 best F1 improves over R500 in the aggregate, not over B0 with clear scene evidence. Stopping behavior remains non-stable, and final metrics and mixed fixed-sample changes are retained.
